methodologyNotes: Dataset covers 10 electric kettle models spanning budget to premium tiers. Primary sources are manufacturer product pages (fellowproducts.com, cosori.com, zwilling.com, hamiltonbeach.com, smeg.com, breville.com, cuisinart.com, bonavitabrand.co) and major retail listings; specs re-verified field-by-field against primary pages on 2026-06-15. Adversarial pass corrected: Zwilling Enfinigy warranty 5->3 years (both base 53105 and Pro 53110 variants, per zwilling.com US product pages stating 3-year warranty); Bonavita base_type corrected from unverified '360-degree swivel' to cordless docking base (swivel claim could not be corroborated from any primary source); Cuisinart MSRP refined 129.99->129.95 per cuisinart.com. Capacity is in liters; booleans indicate feature presence; keep_warm_minutes reports maximum hold duration in minutes (null if absent); warranty_years is the manufacturer's stated US limited warranty; releaseDate reports the year the line debuted commercially (null where unverifiable). All accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.provenance: Adversarially re-verified against the manufacturer Owner's Manual PDF (w11222477-revC). Note: the mandated fetch-clean.mjs harvester only strips HTML and cannot decompress the PDF's FlateDecode content streams — it returned ~55% undecoded binary, in which the only human-readable text was stale XMP artwork metadata reading "KCA 0057 3-Year Limited Warranty" (a red herring, not the actual warranty term). I therefore re-verified against the identical source bytes (downloaded from the same URL, header %PDF-1.6, 2.71 MB) via deterministic PDF text extraction (verbatim, non-paraphrasing). Extracted verbatim: manual header "KEK1565" (exact base model — no sibling/variant/other-capacity mismatch); parts list "1.5 L Electric Kettle", "Hinged lid", "Lid release button", "On/off switch and On indicator light", "Base with power cord", "Cord guide on underside of base"; electrical requirements "Volts: 120 V~", "Hertz: 60 Hz", "Wattage: 1500 W" (and French "Puissance : 1500 W"); warranty section body "One Year Full Warranty from date of purchase." Operation is a single on/off switch that heats water to boiling then shuts off automatically — the manual contains no "temperature", "preset", "degrees", "keep warm", or "gooseneck" text, confirming variable_temp_control=false, gooseneck=false, and keep_warm_minutes=null. base_type is supported by "Base with power cord" + "Cord guide on underside of base" plus the kettle lifting off the base for serving. The manual states no body material (only "interior metal parts"), no US retail price, and no commercial-debut date, so material, priceUsd, and releaseDate remain null. All 8 spec keys retained; 6 non-null values all confirmed verbatim; exact model confirmed.
